g.title: Sheet.288
g.desc: In normal circumstances, R1 is the Active router.
g.text: In normal circumstances, R1 is the Active router.

g.title: Sheet.290
g.desc: When R1 fails, R2 takes over as an Active router.
g.text: When R1 fails, R2 takes over as an Active router.

g.text: When R1 recovers, it doesn’t preempt the Active role by default.

g.title: Sheet.292
g.desc: R2 stays Active even though R1 is up and has higher priority.
g.text: R2 stays Active even though R1 is up and has higher priority.
